name: mongodb
description: Connect to MongoDB databases and MongoDB Atlas clusters from the agent through the official MongoDB MCP server. Run find / aggregate / count queries, insert and update documents, introspect schemas and indexes, manage Atlas clusters, projects, users, and access lists, load the sample dataset, and search the MongoDB knowledge base.

interface.shortDescription: Drive MongoDB and Atlas from the agent via the official MongoDB MCP server.
interface.longDescription: Your agent can work directly with your MongoDB databases — running queries, exploring collections, managing indexes, and even handling Atlas cluster operations. Whether you need to find documents, aggregate data, check schema, or spin up a new Atlas cluster, your agent can do it through natural conversation. No more switching to Compass or the Atlas UI for routine tasks.
defaultPrompt: Show me the collections and indexes in my database.
Find documents matching this criteria and summarize them.
Check the performance and status of my Atlas cluster.
